text:
maria_pm: Quick thread to settle on onramp behaviour for bundles + soft caps. Need a playbook we can put in the purchase flow.

jordan_sales: Customer pilots want: gentle warnings, opt-in burst bundles, and clear post-pilot pricing. They hate surprise invoices. :loud_sound:

kevin_finance: Agreed on clarity. Proposal: three states -> normal, soft-exceed (notifications + auto-deduct burst if purchased), hard-exceed (block or overage invoice). Pricing options: fixed bundle price or per-10k token overage.

sara_legal: Legally we need explicit consent for auto-deducting purchased bundles and a rollback/appeal process. Also define refund rules for unused bundles.

tia_engineer: Implementation constraints: we can gate auto-deduct behind a customer opt-in flag. API sketch: 

```
POST /v1/orgs/:org_id/bundles/allocate
{ "bundle_id": "burst_10k", "target_project": "proj_123", "transferable": true }

GET /v1/orgs/:org_id/usage?from=...&to=...
// returns usage + soft_threshold breaches
```

Server behaviour: when usage >= soft_threshold -> emit event warning.org.soft_exceed and if auto-deduct -> decrement bundle balance and continue. Hard-exceed triggers block unless overage_allowed=true.

alex_p: Product suggestion: default for Starter = hard-block after grace, Pro = auto-deduct if bundle balance exists, Enterprise = priority-lane + unlimited burst purchasable. Transferability default = org-scoped, but allow project-scoped on request.

sam_support: Support burden note: org-scoped transferable credits reduce billing disputes, but we'll need tooling to show allocation history in console.

kevin_finance: Pricing mock (for discussion):
- Burst_10k tokens: $12 (public list)
- Overage per 10k w/out bundle: $18 (1.5x list)
- Monthly burst add-on (100k): $100
We should model margin at different usage distributions before finalizing.

sara_legal: Contract clauses: define grace_period_days, auto-deduct consent checkbox, credits non-refundable except per SOW, termination effects on transferable credits. I'll draft standard language.

maria_pm: Two open decisions: 1) default policy per slab (Starter/Pro/Enterprise), 2) whether to show a pre-commit confirmation modal before auto-deduct. My preference: show modal for Starter, silent auto-deduct for Pro/Enterprise when consented.

jordan_sales: Sales wants the modal off by default for pilots (reduce friction). We can force modal for sticky customers.

tia_engineer: Dev estimate: API & console changes + audit log = 10 dev days + 4 QA days. Transferability + allocation view = additional 6 days.

kevin_finance: I'll run pricing sims and return with P&L scenarios by Tue.

sara_legal: Draft clause in my queue, will post on Friday for review.

sam_support: I'll put a support playbook together with common refund/dispute flows.

billing-bot: Reminder: billing export job runs daily at 03:00 UTC.

maria_pm: Great. Action items: Tia -> prototype API + console mocks (ticket PROD-912), Kevin -> pricing sims (Prod-913), Sara -> SOW language (Prod-914), Sam -> support playbook (Prod-915). We'll vote on defaults in next sync. :white_check_mark:
